introHtml: Alternating beach balls feature panels in two or more colors that repeat around the ball, creating a bold, balanced look that stands out in crowds and photos. This classic style works well for corporate picnics, poolside promotions, and summer giveaways where brand visibility matters. Print your logo on each colored panel using screen printing or pad printing for crisp, durable results that survive repeated inflation and deflation.
